:::{#exm-overall-agreement}
#### Overall agreement for the COVID-19 test

Apply the COVID-19 test of @exm-sensitivity and @exm-specificity
to the [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population) of @exm-prevalence,
with the test as the agent ($A = +$) and the disease status as the reference ($R = D$).
By the [multiplication rule for conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#thm-law-conditional-prob),
with [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity) $\Prf{+ \mid D} = 0.99$,
[specificity](#def-specificity) $\Prf{\neg + \mid \neg D} = 0.99$,
[prevalence](#def-prevalence) $\Prf{D} = 0.07$,
and $\Prf{\neg D} = 0.93$ (@exm-prevalence),
the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) that a person has COVID-19 and tests positive is:

$$
\ba
\Prf{+ \cap D}
&= \Prf{+ \mid D} \cd \Prf{D}
&& \text{(multiplication rule for conditional probability)} \\
&= 0.99 \cd 0.07
&& \text{(substitute the sensitivity and prevalence)} \\
&= 0.0693
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-overall-agreement-pos}

and the probability that a person does not have COVID-19 and tests negative is:

$$
\ba
\Prf{\neg + \cap \neg D}
&= \Prf{\neg + \mid \neg D} \cd \Prf{\neg D}
&& \text{(multiplication rule for conditional probability)} \\
&= 0.99 \cd 0.93
&& \text{(substitute the specificity and } \Prf{\neg D} \text{)} \\
&= 0.9207
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-overall-agreement-neg}

Then the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
p_o
&= \Prf{+ \cap D} + \Prf{\neg + \cap \neg D}
&& \text{(definition of } p_o \text{)} \\
&= 0.0693 + 0.9207
&& \text{(substitute the two joint probabilities)} \\
&= 0.99
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-overall-agreement}

:::
